actionConfiguration.body: WITH lidor_types AS ( SELECT unnest(ARRAY[ 'קיבלו כסף', 'מסלקה (אוטומציה)', 'שכר מעל 10 (ללא יפוי כח)', 'סגור (לא זכאי)', 'ליד גמאביז', 'שנתית' ]) AS t ), new_today AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.identity_number) l.type FROM leads l JOIN customers c ON c.id = l.customer_id WHERE l.created_at::date BETWEEN '{{moment(_DatePicker_Start.selectedDate).format("YYYY-MM-DD")}}'::date AND '{{moment(DatePicker_End.selectedDate).format("YYYY-MM-DD")}}'::date AND l.type IN (SELECT t FROM lidor_types) ORDER BY c.identity_number, l.created_at DESC ) SELECT lt.t AS "סוג_ליד", COALESCE(COUNT(nt.type), 0) AS "כמות" FROM lidor_types lt LEFT JOIN new_today nt ON nt.type = lt.t GROUP BY lt.t ORDER BY "כמות" DESC
